name: Martin Summer
source:
A guest staying in Room 211 (Honor). An author who likes wine and food. 

[Spoiler]It is later revealed that he's a plagiarist who stole Alan Parker's manuscript and published it under his own name.[/spoiler]

[Based on the [url=https://cing.fandom.com/wiki/Martin_Summer]wiki[/url]]
